messages:
sarah: Customer on Private region eu-central is failing to upload debug bundle via presigned URL — they get a 403. I have a request id from the collector: req-7c9f1a2b. Can we collect repro steps and a safe bundle to ask them to upload?


dan: @sarah can you paste the exact curl they used and a small excerpt of the collector log around the error? Also which collector version are they running?


sarah: collector version 2.4.1. curl they used: 
```bash
curl -v -X PUT "https://private-storage.example.local/presign/abc123" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
  --upload-file debug-bundle.tar.gz
```


sarah: collector log snippet (redacted):
```
2026-02-11T14:05:02Z collector[2142]: upload start req=req-7c9f1a2b
2026-02-11T14:05:04Z collector[2142]: http put failed status=403 url="https://private-storage.example.local/presign/abc123" x-request-id=req-7c9f1a2b
2026-02-11T14:05:04Z collector[2142]: error: upload denied, signature mismatch
```


leo: two quick things to check: 1) clock skew on the customer's uploader machine (signed URLs TTL are short), 2) any proxy or man-in-the-middle rewriting headers.


julie: for Private installs we've seen intermittent 403s when the presign TTL default is 90s and the upload goes through a slow corporate proxy. Ask customer to try a direct upload from an internet-connected host or use SFTP fallback.


mika (support-bot): Recommended debug-bundle collection command for Private with redaction and verification:
```bash
debug-bundle collect --out /tmp/redwood-debug-req-7c9f1a2b.tgz \
  --include-collector-logs /var/log/redwood/collector.log \
  --collector-version 2.4.1 \
  --redact --verify-redaction
```


mika (support-bot): Note: --redact runs the local redactor ruleset (email, ssn, credit_card, long_keys). --verify-redaction will fail the bundle if PII is detected after redaction so we can catch issues before upload.


dan: If presigned upload still fails, instruct customer to upload to our bastion via scp as a fallback. Example:
```bash
scp debug-bundle.tar.gz support@bastion.eu-central.redwood:/home/support/uploads/req-7c9f1a2b.tar.gz
```


leo: for repro collection ask them to include: collector.log (±5m), /etc/hosts, output of `date -u` on the uploader machine, and the exact curl command. That lets us verify clock drift.


julie: redaction checklist for customer question: we redact common PII by default (emails, phone numbers, IBAN/CC-like numbers, JWTs). We do NOT automatically redact entire payload fields unless they match rules — if they want aggressive redaction use `--redact-level high` and we'll replace long strings with hashes.


sarah: I'll send the commands to the customer and request a new bundle collected with the debug-bundle tool plus the `date -u` output. I'll also request they try scp to the bastion if presign fails again.


oncall-bot: Created INC-2357 and attached initial logs. Handoff scheduled for 09:30 CET.


dan: one more thing — if the redactor fails (we had a bug in 2.4.1 with nested JSON arrays), ask them to run `debug-bundle collect --no-redact` and upload to oss-safe staging, then we run redaction server-side. Only do this if customer approves PII transmission to support.


sarah: good call. I'll include the options and get confirmation. Will update thread once we have the new bundle or scp success.
